missing_methods.intent: Get user profile name from dashboard header
missing_methods.detailed_requirements: Locate the user profile name element in the dashboard header and return its text value. This method should wait for the element to be visible and extract the displayed username or profile name.

missing_methods.intent: Assert user profile name is visible in dashboard header
missing_methods.detailed_requirements: Verify that the user profile name element is visible in the dashboard header and optionally assert that it matches the expected name. This method should wait for the element to be visible and return a boolean or raise an assertion error if not visible or if the name doesn't match.
